nonClaims: This is a normative closure plan, not a selected proof grammar, transcript, hash, wrapper codec, covenant, proof, or execution result.
Sibling unlocking-bytecode introspection feasibility is not proof-session soundness evidence.
No splice witness is captured and no proof-session blocker is closed.
No relation refreeze, qualification, or measurement admission is claimed.

anchorWrapperGrammar: membershipDigestVector = exactly carrierCount ordered bytes32 section-leaf digests as one canonical pushed element
sectionPayload bytes as one canonical pushed element
plannedClosure.noSighashSubstitution: The external funding signature uses the historical whole-output-binding mode but does not bind sibling unlocking bytecodes and may never substitute for proof-session root, anchor, wrapper, ordinal, or transcript checks.
nonAnchorWrapperGrammar: sectionPayload bytes as one canonical pushed element
ordinalScheduleRules: carrierCount equals the exact persistent carrier count selected by the deployment manifest
ordinals are canonical 0 through carrierCount minus 1 in wire order
each ordinal occurs exactly once and each section payload is consumed completely
the ordered sections are non-overlapping and collectively exhaustive for the selected proof grammar
every carrier validates its own expected role, input index, ordinal, root, checkpoint, manifest digest, section grammar, and successor

proofSessionRootPlan.canonicalPreimage: ASCII PoolActionFv1/ProofSessionRoot/v1 || exact PAST || proofSecurityProfileDigest extracted from and equal to PAST || carrierManifestDigest extracted from and equal to PAST || u16le(carrierCount) || transcriptCheckpoint || the ordered sequence of u16le(ordinal) || u16le(sectionLength) || SectionDigest(ASCII PoolActionFv1/ProofSection/v1 || u16le(ordinal) || raw sectionPayload)
exclusions: all serialized anchor and non-anchor wrapper bytes, including wrapper magic, encoded lengths, supplied roots, checkpoints, and membership vectors
any encoding of the complete proof or complete unlocking bytecodes
proofSessionRootPlan.nonSelfReferenceRule: Only exact raw section payloads, their recomputed ordered leaf digests, and the explicitly listed non-wrapper session fields enter the root preimage. Section payloads and the transcript checkpoint must be defined independently of proofSessionRoot; hashing a supplied membership vector, full proof bytes, or any root-bearing wrapper is forbidden.
proofSessionRootPlan.selectedFunctionRule: Use only the 32-byte commitment function pinned by the immutable proof security profile.

rootAndMembershipOwnership.authoritativeRootEnforcer: the state covenant at stateInputIndex 0, and no other independently authoritative enforcer
carrierMembershipDuties: fully parse its own canonical wrapper and section payload and authenticate the same sole anchor at carrierAnchorInputIndex 1
recompute its own SectionDigest from its exact raw section payload, ordinal, and length
verify membershipDigestCount equals carrierCount, the anchor vector has exactly carrierCount ordered bytes32 leaves, and its own recomputed leaf equals the vector entry at its exact ordinal
recompute the root from the authenticated exact PAST, PAST-extracted profile and manifest digests, carrierCount, transcriptCheckpoint, and authenticated ordered leaf vector
require its recomputed root, its wrapper root, the sole anchor root, and the state-covenant-authenticated root to be byte-identical
verify its exact ordinal, input index, proof schedule, section grammar, and persistent successor role
rootAndMembershipOwnership.noSelfSuppliedRootAuthority: No carrier validates only a root supplied in its own wrapper. A per-carrier root, membership vector, profile, manifest, count, checkpoint, or anchor is never an independent authority; whole-transaction acceptance requires the state covenant's all-section recomputation and every carrier's local leaf-membership and same-anchor checks to succeed.
rootAndMembershipOwnership.orderedMembershipEncoding: The sole anchor carries exactly carrierCount ordered bytes32 leaf digests. It is an authenticated membership witness only: the state covenant must replace trust in it with recomputation from all raw section payloads, while each carrier checks its own leaf at its ordinal and recomputes the same root from the full ordered vector.
rootAndMembershipOwnership.rootBearingWrapperExclusion: Anchor and carrier wrappers, their supplied proofSessionRoot fields, and the serialized membership vector are excluded as bytes from the root preimage; only the state-recomputed ordered leaf values represented by that vector enter the preimage.
stateCovenantDuties: fully parse the sole anchor and every carrier unlocking bytecode with no prefix-only parse, suffix, omitted element, duplicate element, or unconsumed byte
read the exact raw section payload from every carrier input in canonical input and ordinal order, excluding every root-bearing wrapper and supplied membership vector from the root preimage
extract proofSecurityProfileDigest and carrierManifestDigest from the exact 589-byte PAST and reject every independent or unequal copy
recompute every ordered section-leaf digest from its raw section payload, exact ordinal, and exact length
recompute proofSessionRoot from exact PAST, its extracted profile and manifest digests, exact carrierCount, transcriptCheckpoint, and the complete ordered recomputed section-leaf sequence

require the anchor membershipDigestVector to equal the complete ordered recomputed section-leaf sequence and require the anchor and every carrier to carry or authenticate the same recomputed proofSessionRoot
reject before state transition if any carrier wrapper, payload, ordinal, length, leaf, membership vector, root, checkpoint, profile, manifest, or count disagrees

topology.anchorReadRule: Every carrier must authenticate the complete carrier-anchor unlocking bytecode through sibling-input unlocking-bytecode introspection and must compare its local session fields to the canonical anchor.
topology.otherCarrierInputs: contiguous wire-order inputs after index 1, with ordinal equal to inputIndex minus 1
topology.soleAnchorRule: The state covenant and every carrier input must authenticate one byte-identical sole anchor at carrierAnchorInputIndex 1. Any alternate anchor, duplicate authority, per-input root, per-input checkpoint, or independently supplied session fact is forbidden.
topology.stateCovenantAnchorRule: The state covenant at stateInputIndex 0 must authenticate the same sole carrier-anchor unlocking bytecode and the same exact PAST, carrierCount, proofSessionRoot, transcriptCheckpoint, carrierManifestDigest, wrapper version, and ordinal schedule authenticated by every carrier; no independently supplied state-side session fact is authoritative.

transcriptCheckpointPlan.protocolRequirement: The selected Circle-FRI protocol must expose one canonical commitment checkpoint with no new PAST field or changed state. Otherwise the Fv2 kill condition is met.
schedule: absorb every proof-wide commitment in one selected chronological order
derive one canonical 32-byte commitment checkpoint before carrier-local query or section challenges
derive one session identifier and fork each carrier transcript by ASCII carrier-section, ordinal, and carrierManifestDigest

unlockingBytecodeLimits.completeConsumptionRule: Both the state covenant's all-carrier parser and each carrier's local parser must consume its canonical pushed wrapper and section elements completely and reject every suffix, truncation, alternate push encoding, omitted field, duplicate field, declared-length mismatch, or unconsumed byte.

requiredEvidence: one complete current-standard transaction whose total serialized size is at most 100000 bytes
complete parser-consumption evidence for every carrier unlocking bytecode and every canonical pushed wrapper, membership, section, and redeem-script element
rejection evidence for a 100001-byte aggregate transaction and for each single-byte wrapper or element overrun

lengthFieldRules: Every u16 length is an encoding field only, never an independent permission to exceed a BCH byte ceiling.
Every declared wrapper, membership-vector, section, section-payload, and redeem-script byte length must equal the exact canonically serialized byte length and must be at most 10000.
Every canonical pushed wrapper, membership-vector, section, section-payload, and redeem-script element must be at most 10000 bytes under the May 2025 element ceiling.

Every complete carrier unlocking bytecode, including all push opcodes, encoded length fields, wrapper bytes, membership witness bytes, section payload, redeem script, and any other serialized overhead, must be at most 10000 bytes under MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE.
Canonical minimal push encoding is mandatory and every push opcode and length prefix counts toward the complete unlocking-bytecode limit.

maxSectionPayloadBytes.derivationScope: derive independently for every concrete anchor/non-anchor wrapper role and ordinal, then use the minimum permitted section payload bound required by the selected carrier schedule
maxSectionPayloadBytes.nonClaim: No numerical section-payload maximum is asserted until the concrete canonical wrapper, push encodings, membership witness, and redeem-script overhead are byte-counted.

requiredSingleInvariantFalsifiers: splice a section payload from another proof while preserving its ordinal
duplicate one ordinal and omit another
alter the anchor PAST while retaining local carrier wrappers
alter one local root or transcript checkpoint while retaining the anchor
alter the state-covenant copy of any sole anchor or session fact while retaining every carrier wrapper
make the state covenant accept an independently supplied root, checkpoint, manifest digest, count, wrapper version, or ordinal schedule
make a carrier accept only a root supplied in its own wrapper without authenticating the state-recomputed sole-anchor root
alter a nonlocal raw section payload while keeping one carrier's local section, claimed membership vector, and root unchanged
alter one anchor membership-vector leaf while keeping the corresponding raw section payload unchanged
encode a 10001-byte canonical pushed wrapper, membership, section, section-payload, or redeem-script element
serialize a 10001-byte carrier unlocking bytecode whose individual pushed elements are each at most 10000 bytes
use a matching u16 length above 10000 or a mismatched u16 length at or below 10000
claim a maxSectionPayloadBytes value before exact canonical wrapper, push, membership, and redeem-script overhead is derived
present a later qualification transaction whose aggregate serialized size is 100001 bytes
append an unconsumed byte to a section payload or wrapper
construct a root preimage that includes its own root-bearing wrapper
accept solely because a funding signature remains valid after sibling unlocking-bytecode substitution
